key_insight: The proposed framework combines ontology-grounded knowledge with multi-agent reasoning to make differential diagnosis more explicit, traceable, and explainable.
clinical_relevance: It aims to support clinical reasoning by linking diagnostic hypotheses to structured evidence and asking targeted questions about missing symptoms.
method: Ground diagnostic inference in an expert-curated medical ontology.
Decompose reasoning into explicit, auditable multi-agent steps.
Identify discriminative missing symptoms and generate follow-up questions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports publicly available source code but provides no dataset details, quantitative results, or clinical validation.
watch_item: Reliability may depend on ontology coverage and accuracy; the claimed diagnostic benefits require empirical validation.
paper_title: Ontology-guided multi-agent reasoning for explainable differential diagnosis
